_notes: API: Hydrochlorothiazide (HCT). Visible label: 'A6 R6 P9/2 HCT'.
100% standard: 2 mg/mL × 2 µL spotting volume = 4.000 µg/spot.
Solvent: Acetone (per TLCyzer Table 1).
Lane order in portrait (left→right): 60%, 90%, 80%, 90%, 100%.
SWITCHED TO POLYNOMIAL 2026-07-10: top-hat (SE=140.25px) left a real residual
spatial-illumination bias across the row (confirmed via cross-validation
against TLCyzer's own app on the same photo — see memory/task-tlcyzer-
cross-validation), giving lane2=68.4% / lane4=105.8% recovery for two
spots both declared 90%. Root cause: genuine left-right illumination
gradient in the source photo (matches the TLCyzer paper's own Table 4
finding that off-centre UV lamp position skews recovery), which a local
morphological opening (top-hat) does not fully flatten. The global quartic
polynomial (Option A, same formula as TLCyzer's paper) handles the middle
of the row far better: re-run interactively with polynomial background,
lane2=87.3% / lane4=86.2% (both within ~4% of true, agreeing with each
other to ~1 point) — dramatic improvement. Reference recovery (lanes 1/3/5)
is still noisy (R²=0.2066) because lane5 (near the right plate edge) is
under-corrected by the same global polynomial's known edge weakness — the
two metrics pull in opposite directions for this image; polynomial was
chosen because the metric that matters (unknown-spot accuracy) improved
enormously and the reference-only R² is not itself a validation target.
REBUILT 2026-07-10 (earlier same day): original fixture (2026-06-29) had
hand-transcribed corners predating the CSV corner-export feature, which
produced a scale-mismatched warp — real spots landed ~250px away from the
recorded fractions, so auto-detection found 0/5 spots regardless of
threshold or background method. Re-opened the plugin interactively,
re-picked the four corners properly, exported exact numbers via the CSV
corner-export feature — this fixed 5/5 auto-detection under top-hat, and
the switch to polynomial (this update) reused a fresh corner pick, not
the same corners as the top-hat run (both are valid picks of the same
four physical plate corners; ~5-10px apart from re-clicking).
Corners recorded by the plugin are in EXIF-rotated portrait display space
(Fiji applies EXIF orientation=6 when opening the JPEG); the runner loads
the raw landscape JPEG via ImageIO (no EXIF applied). Converted portrait
(px,py) -> landscape (lx,ly) via: lx = py, ly = (1949-1) - px.
Plate image: 41598_2022_17527_MOESM3_ESM.jpg (4096×1949 px).
Source: Hauk et al., Sci. Rep. 12, 13433 (2022), Supplementary Figure S4.
_thresholdNote: Interactive UI: polynomial background, threshold 1.0 -> 5/5 spots auto-detected directly, but the headless ValidationRunner's LOO fold for lane1 (held out, predicted from lanes 3+5 only) blows up to 253% recovery at threshold 1.0 because SpotDetector's connected-component radius for lane1 is anomalous at that exact threshold. Threshold=0.80 gives lane1 a materially different (better-behaved) auto-detected radius, fixing the LOO extrapolation blowup (253% -> 72%) and dropping overall RSD 53.31% -> 16.07%. Trade-off: lanes 4/5 fall back to manual (fixture-coordinate) detection at 0.80 rather than true shape-based auto-detection -- acceptable here since their coordinates are hand-verified from the real interactive CSV export, but worth knowing this isn't '5/5 real auto-detect' at this specific threshold the way top-hat was. RSD is threshold-sensitive in this range (0.75 -> 32.68%, 0.80/0.82 -> ~16%, 0.88 -> 18.62%) -- not a knife-edge but not fully robust either; flagged for future investigation, not fully understood mechanistically. | 2026-09-01: threshold unified to 1.0 (the plain image mean) across all fixtures; was 0.80. The per-plate values existed to work around a residual illumination gradient left by fitting the quartic background in linearised sRGB. Detection now runs on raw sRGB and integration on linear light (CLAUDE.md, 'Colour space — two images, not one'), so all three plates auto-detect 5/5 at the plain mean and per-plate threshold tuning is no longer needed. Any reasoning above about threshold sensitivity is superseded.
_cornerNote: Landscape-space corners, converted from portrait CSV export (see _notes). lx=py, ly=1948-px.
_spotNote: xFraction/yFraction taken from CSV centroid_x_fraction/centroid_y_fraction (plugin run 2026-07-10, polynomial background).
